title: Exact pre-provenance v1 custody attestation compatibility shape
description: Accepts only the exact first pushed v1 attestation for historical public-safety scanning.

transport_profile.const: encrypted restic through the restricted SFTP fallback

repository_verification.const: every stored data blob was read without error

restore.const: the exact remote snapshot restored into a new isolated target

restored_verification.const: ten allowlisted source files matched the private manifest; four canonical artifact/version records validated; two content objects matched their digests; the restored Git bundle verified

storage_boundary.const: ZFS-backed repository with a separately controlled weekly snapshot timer and bounded retention; a manual server-controlled post-write snapshot succeeded after the first remote backup

recovery_cadence.const: monthly restic integrity verification and quarterly isolated restore rehearsal
